purpose: Probe whether the unmodified universal scorer detects crying (EfficientAT) and seductive (CLAP) when those emotions are synthesized from ceiling originals.

samantha.reason: Universal ceiling windows w00-w07 match this file: last window w06_15.000_17.407 and duration 17.407188s at 44100 Hz stereo. Identical sha256 to cloning-v2/hf-samantha/inputs/original.wav and similarity/inputs/samantha-original.wav.

jarvis.reason: Universal ceiling windows w00-w05 match this file: duration 15.9520625s at 48000 Hz stereo (last 0.952s shorter than the 1.2s window floor, so no w06). Identical sha256 to cloning-v2/hf-jarvis/inputs/original.wav and similarity/inputs/jarvis-original.wav.

tts.note: Chatterbox Turbo ONNX has no exaggeration/CFG/emotion input (graph scan). Emotion via official tokenizer special tokens plus text and --pace. Defaults otherwise unchanged: dtype fp32, temperature 0, seed 0, repetition_penalty 1.2, ep cpu, intra-threads 2.

lines.text: [crying] I... I didn't think it would end like this. [sniff] I'm sorry. I just can't stop.
[crying] Please don't leave me. [sniff] I don't know how to do this without you.
[crying] It hurts so much. [sigh] I keep thinking about everything we lost.
[crying] I tried to be strong, but [sniff] I can't hold it in anymore.
[whispering] Come closer. I've been waiting for you all night.
[whispering] Stay with me. Just like this. Slow. Close.
Come here. You know exactly what I want. Don't rush. Stay close to me.
[sigh] [whispering] Don't say a word. Just come a little closer to me.
We checked the numbers twice this afternoon, and the results are clear.
Could you open the living room window before dinner starts?
[happy] I am so glad you made it. This is the best news I have heard all week.
[happy] That was wonderful. I cannot stop smiling. You did it!
[fear] Something is wrong. I think someone is following us. We have to get out of here.
[fear] Do not turn around. I heard a noise downstairs. I am really scared.
[sigh] I miss them every day. It has not been the same since they left.
[sigh] I keep thinking about what I should have said, and now it is too late.

sad.note: No [crying] token — distinguishes sad speech from the crying probe

lines.text: [surprised] What? You are here? I had no idea you were coming tonight!
[surprised] Wait. Did you just say we won? I cannot believe it!
That is disgusting. I cannot believe anyone would do something so vile.
Ugh, that smell is revolting. Get it away from me right now.

disgust.note: No official tokenizer token for disgust

lines.text: [angry] Do not lie to me. I know exactly what you did, and I will not let it go.
[angry] Back off. You have no right to speak to me that way.

aggressive.why: present on Samantha original (strength 0.999), missing on Jarvis

lines.text: I love you so much. You mean everything to me, and I am so grateful you are here.
Come here, my love. I have been thinking about you all day.

love.why: present on Samantha original (strength 0.8109), missing on Jarvis

lines.text: [laugh] Oh that is too funny. I cannot believe you actually said that.
[chuckle] Ha, you got me. That was a good one. I needed that.

laughter.why: present on Samantha original (strength 0.2744), missing on Jarvis

note_whisper: whisper is not a universal-scorer category (no detector). [whispering] was already used as a TTS control on seductive lines. No separate whisper probe.
